name: A Nonmaximum Conditioning of a Maximum Class
properties: $M$ has $11=1+4+\binom42$ members and VC dimension $2$, so it is maximum. Its $z=0$ section is $K\cup\{\{1,2\}\}$, which has VC dimension $2$ but only five members on three active coordinates, below the maximum size seven. Thus the section is ample but not maximum.
